news.title: Purdue Engineering names four winners of faculty Thinky Competition focused on AI
news.summary_en: This summer, Purdue Engineering faculty created innovative web apps, AI skills, and agents in support of teaching and learning, combining their strong technical domain knowledge with critical human judgment.

news.title: ECE's Zhu partners with HHS researchers on new nutrition AI tool
news.summary_en: New nutrition AI tools developed by Purdue University researchers could improve how scientists measure diet by capturing eating behaviors in real time instead of relying solely on participants’ recollections.

news.summary_en: New programs prepare the next generation in the capital city and beyond
